outs.note: The show said Williams is probably out for the entire season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Chet Holmgren is out eight to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear and will not need surgery. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Jaylin Williams missed his fourth straight game Tuesday with back spasms.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Trey Murphy III is probable for Wednesday at Brooklyn after sitting Monday on the second night of a back-to-back to manage his knees.
Yves Missi is out Wednesday at Brooklyn with a left knee contusion and bone bruise, his 10th straight missed game.
Trendon Watford is out Wednesday at Brooklyn with a right ankle sprain, his second straight absence.
Mikel Brown Jr. sat out Sunday at Dallas because he is not yet cleared for back-to-backs as he comes back from a back injury.
Nolan Traore was questionable for Brooklyn at New Orleans. The show said he has played well this season and is shooting about 46% from three on modest volume.
Ja Morant is out at least four weeks with a left hamstring strain.
Devin Vassell was questionable for San Antonio at Chicago. The show said Stokastic sims have Victor Wembanyama playing about one extra minute when Vassell is out.
The show listed Norman Powell as questionable with a shoulder issue after an earlier back issue. He missed the Nov 8 game, and the show said Chicago looked much better without him.

injuries.text: Joel Embiid hurt his ankle before halftime on November 10 but played the second half and finished with 16 points and 6 rebounds in 31 minutes. The show said his usage has dropped and his shooting has been poor, though he got to the line often.
Precious Achiuwa started Tuesday against Orlando but left in the third quarter with a left lower-leg contusion after 14 minutes and did not return.
